title: Parameter - Attribute Unquoted
description: The parameter is echoed in an HTML attribute, unquoted. i.e. <div data-value=%q>. The attacker can inject new attributes or event handlers by using a space.
php:
Parameter - Attribute Unquoted

The q parameter is echoed in an HTML attribute without quotes.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected output (inspect the element below):

style="padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,255,157,0.05);"> This element has an unquoted data-value attribute.
Inspect this element to see the injection point.
objectives: Inject a new attribute by adding a space to break out of the current value.
Add an event handler attribute like onmouseover or onfocus.
Understand the difference between quoted and unquoted attribute injection.
hints: The context is: <div data-value=[INPUT]> with no quotes.
A space character ends the attribute value and allows new attributes.
